plan: This is a second-price auction where bidding my true value is the weakly dominant strategy. Since the winner pays the second-highest bid (not their own bid), there's no benefit to bidding above or below my true value of $28. Bidding exactly my value ensures I win whenever it's profitable to do so (when my value exceeds others' bids) and never overpay, since I'll only pay what the second-highest bidder bid, which will always be less than my value if I win.

This is a second-price auction, so bidding my true value is the dominant strategy. Bidding exactly $36 ensures I win whenever the second-highest bid is below my value (guaranteeing positive profit) and I never overpay since I only pay the second-highest bid if I win. Bidding higher than 36 risks paying more than my value if I "win" against someone bidding between 36 and my inflated bid. Bidding lower risks losing profitable auctions. Therefore, $36 is optimal.
